data.title: Order to remove garden waste (Ordnungsverfügung)
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt's public order office (Ordnungsamt) ordered you to remove garden waste dumped on the city green space behind your property at Lindenweg 12 by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) at an estimated €480.00.
data.explanation: The city says garden waste was dumped on the municipal green area behind your property and orders you to remove it completely by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city may have it removed and bill you, estimated at €480.00. You may also challenge the order in court (Klage) at the administrative court, with no prior objection step. The app shows until when. Consider getting legal advice if you think the order is wrong, for example if the waste isn't yours.

items.title: Remove garden waste
items.action: Completely remove the dumped garden waste from the green space behind your property.
items.consequence: The city will carry out substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) at your expense, estimated at €480.00.
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026

items.title: Deadline to file court action (Klage)

date.text: binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.action: If you want to challenge the order, file a written court action with the administrative court or record it at the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
